signals.text: Revenue grew 29% a year over 3 years vs 32% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 16% vs revenue at 29%: profits are lagging sales.
Operating margin compressed 249 bps in 3 years (12.0% → 9.5%).
Borrowings grew 3.3x in 3 years while equity grew 1.3x: growth is being funded with debt.
Working-capital days shortened by 23 days in 3 years (51 → 28).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 43% of reported profit: profits are not converting to cash, a red flag.

guidance.statement: Titan sticks to its previous guidance of around 11% center of gravity for jewellery margins.
guidance.quote: we will stick with our previous guidance. We are not changing it.

guidance.statement: TEAL's normalized margin would gradually gravitate towards 12% to 15%, 16% over the long term.
guidance.quote: the normalized margin would gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.

guidance.statement: Titan targets a healthy double-digit aggressive growth in the jewellery business.
guidance.quote: we are targeting, as always, a double-digit aggressive growth

guidance.statement: CaratLane's normal trajectory should be towards 10% EBIT margin.
guidance.quote: their normal trajectory should be towards 10%.

delivered.statement: Consolidated level realization of customs duty rate increase was ₹407 crores.
Normalized EBIT margin for Tanishq Mia Zoya business for the quarter was 10.9%.
Buyer growth for the jewellery segment was 5% for the quarter.
CaratLane delivered an EBIT margin of 9.6% for the quarter.

calls.tone: confident on demand, resilient execution, and optimistic about long-term growth despite short-term volatility

pushback.gist: Analysts pressed on whether jewellery EBIT growth or margin guidance should be revised given the recent strong performance.
Skepticism on how the company will maintain 18-20% top-line growth if Y-o-Y gold price inflation turns zero.
Questions on whether competitive intensity in making charges and discounts on diamond value has increased.

business.summary: Titan Company Limited operates lifestyle businesses including jewellery, watches, eyecare, and subsidiaries like CaratLane and TEAL, making money primarily through retail and manufacturing of branded lifestyle products.

segments.name: Jewellery
segments.note: Includes Tanishq, Mia, Zoya, CaratLane, and Rivaah.

guidance.statement: Titan expects a 15% to 20% compound annual growth rate for the jewellery business over the next 3-5 years.
guidance.quote: between 15% to 20%. So, in a sense, that holds good and we hope to do that and maybe do a bit better... three to four years, what should be the growth. I think India growth story and the formalization of this sector will land you in this space.

guidance.statement: Titan plans to scale up beYon lab-grown diamond stores to 10 to 12 locations across two to three cities.
guidance.quote: our objective currently is very soon to scale up to the next step of 10 to 12 stores and then kind of see how that works for us before planning a national launch.

delivered.statement: Analog watches overall growth was 16% for the full year FY26.
Total Watches division overall growth was 14% for the full year FY26.
Jewellery buyer growth surged by 8% in Q4 FY26 compared to flattish growth in prior months.
CaratLane grew to the tune of 22% to 23% for the period.
Eyecare Revenue growth clocked almost 16% to 17%.

calls.tone: Confident on demand growth and category formalization, cautious on margin pressures from product mix and international challenges.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned potential cost increases and sourcing disruptions due to import license delays.
Pressured on the sharp increase in international subsidiary losses and GCC market disruptions.
Repeated questioning on the ability to sustain domestic jewellery margins amid rising gold prices and product mix changes.
Scepticism regarding whether CaratLane's growth deceleration was due to a consumer shift towards Tanishq gold jewellery.

guidance.statement: CaratLane will gradually inch towards double-digit EBIT margin with scale.
guidance.quote: gradually, CaratLane with the scale will start inching towards double-digit EBIT margin.

delivered.statement: Titan consolidated revenue benefited from a festive quarter with robust jewellery performance.
Consolidated labour code impact of INR152 crores was accounted for as an exceptional item.
Titan completed 67% stake acquisition of Damas, with consolidation starting January 1st.
Eyewear domestic omnichannel sales grew by 17.5% with overall revenue growth at 11%.
New buyer contribution in the jewellery segment reached 45% for the quarter.

calls.tone: Confident on demand momentum and festive execution despite rising gold price volatility and margin pressures.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned gross margin contraction and sustainability of margins in a rising gold price environment.
Scepticism regarding flat buyer growth offset by massive ticket size expansion in plain gold.
Pressed on whether permanent discounting is required to manage higher making charges from gold inflation.

guidance.statement: Target 35 to 40 new Tanishq store openings for the full year.
guidance.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target.

guidance.statement: YTD December growth rates should become better than first half growth rates.
guidance.quote: by the time we end -- we come to YTD December, our growth rates should have become better than the first half growth rates.

guidance.statement: Watches business margins to gradually revert towards 15% to 16% over the 1-2 year timeframe.
guidance.quote: mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.

guidance.statement: Eyewear business is expected to close the year at 13% to 14% growth.
guidance.quote: we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.

guidance.statement: Expect 70 to 80 store expansions and renovations for the year.
guidance.quote: overall, for the renovations, etcetera, 70 to 80 may be the orders that may happen for the year.

delivered.statement: Watches festive period sales saw a 16% growth over last year's similar period.
CaratLane margins expanded 250 bps year-on-year to reach 10% in Q2.
International jewellery business transformed from a loss in the previous year to a profit.
High-value studded jewellery contribution gained 1 percentage point over last year Q2.

calls.tone: Management is satisfied with Q2 performance and festive demand, but cautious regarding gold price volatility impacts on margins.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned consumer willingness, volume elasticity, and inventory sustainability amid parabolic gold price hikes.
Pressing on flat-to-declining buyer growth trends and what distinct steps are being taken to address them.
Skeptical questioning on the large increase in consolidated inventory and its subsequent impact on GML interest.
Questions on whether historical EBIT margins are achievable and if exchange schemes or rising gold prices pressure margins.

guidance.statement: Limited number of new store additions planned for FY27 in key markets.
guidance.quote: with a limited number of new store additions planned for Financial Year 2026-27 in key markets

guidance.statement: Target to become Operational Carbon Net Zero (Scope 1 and Scope 2) by FY30.
guidance.quote: Operational Carbon Net Zero (Scope 1 and Scope 2) by Financial Year 2029-30

guidance.statement: Target to become Water Positive by Financial Year 2029-30.
Target 50% reduction and recycling of plastics by Financial Year 2029-30.
guidance.quote: 50% reduction and recycling of plastics by Financial Year 2029-30

delivered.statement: Total revenue from operations grew by 41% to Rs 77,554 crore.
Net profit grew by 39% to Rs 4,630 crore.
Jewellery business revenue grew by 31% to Rs 61,148 crore.
Watches Division recorded revenue of Rs 5,233 crore, a growth of 14%.
EyeCare Division revenue grew by 14% to Rs 907 crore.
Emerging businesses recorded consolidated revenue of Rs 508 crore, growth of 25%.

calls.tone: Cautiously optimistic amidst global uncertainties, geopolitical volatility, and elevated gold prices.
